wrong code: x1's address is kept in XBC across cal ._fneg_d and used at the join (no oracle code relies on a register but HL or XIZ surviving an FP helper) (fixed: 6dd2ee4e8)
wrong code: ld DE,0x0 hoisted above a branch reaches the second ._fcmp_d by a path where the first ._fcmp_d has clobbered DE (the relation code is junk) (fixed: bfdb0cb5b)
wrong code: s1 += strspn() is added to (XSP+0x8) while the two arguments are still pushed, i.e. to the saved XIZ, not to s1 (in XIZ) (fixed: 68f9fbde4)
wrong code: the loop tests XBC (junk after C9H_divlu) instead of the quotient, so it never ends; str is kept in XDE across the helper calls (fixed: 05bfa0948 (now refused))
UB only: y is read before any assignment (y = f * 2.0 + f / y; x / y), so the result depends on what the frame slot held; the model and the oracle allot y different slots (E3)
UB only: gua[b] / guca[b] with b out of the array (negative or huge): the model zero-extends a memory index where V4.23 sign-extends a homed one; in range they agree

index out of range: gca[b] with the int parameter b = 0xffff (edge trial); the model zero-extends the index (ld BC,(XSP+0xc) / extz XBC / add XBC,XWA), the oracle indexes (XIX+DE), which sign-extends; both outside gca[16] (UB)

UB only: gula[b] with b = 0x13b6 reads past the array, so the branches taken differ
UB only: gca[t] with a negative char t (the model zero-extends the spilled char, the oracle keeps t in E and sign-extends)
UB only: gca[a] with a negative (0xb4cf): the model zero-extends the IZ-homed int index (ld BC,IZ / extz XBC / add XBC,XWA) where V4.23 reads (XWA+IZ); in range they agree
UB only: gca[t] %= 16 with t = gi arbitrary (0x8000 and larger): out of the array; the model zero-extends the index (extz XBC / add XBC,XWA) where V4.23 uses lda XBC,XWA+IZ
UB only: gca[t] with t = gia[1] & *gpi arbitrary, then guca[u] with the char read there: out of the array (edge / full trials only)
UB only: guca[c] with c = (char)0xff: the model zero-extends the slot-held char index (ld XWA,0x0 / ld A,(XSP+0xc) / add XWA,XBC) where V4.23 reads (XWA+E); in range they agree

index out of range: guca[t] /= 7 with t = rc(gi2) a char of 0x80..0xff held in QIZH; the model zero-extends it (ld XWA,0x0 / ld A,QIZH / add XWA,XBC), the oracle's lda XBC,XWA+QIZH sign-extends; both outside guca[16] (UB)

index out of range: gca[c] = hca[c] / hc << c with an int c of 0x8000..0xffff (edge / full trials); the -O store planner extends the index whole (extz XDE / add XDE,XWA) where the oracle indexes the array with the 16-bit register, which sign-extends; both outside gca[8] (UB).  The twelve other X value kinds matched the oracle once the planner ran under -O (2026-11-10)

a char negated in the compare: the model's -O path negates the sign-extended word (ld A,(_gc) / exts WA / neg WA / cp WA,0x7), as C's promotion says; cc900 negates the byte, so -(-128) stays -128 there and the compare goes the other way at the edge; a cc900 narrowing the model imitates without -O (cw_char_derived) and under -O from the next commit
